scope.zh: 随机插曲：间谍头子暴露

texts.zh:
发生了严重违规行为！间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在一次秘访[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]地表时不慎暴露了踪迹。目前事故的细节仍在调查中，但[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]与当地的[from.target.GetSpeciesName]发生了短暂但直接的接触，他们一瞬间便落荒而逃。我们的特工尽力抓捕目击者，但目前仍一无所获。

[from.GetName]行动仍在进展当中，但我们将采取特殊措施来遏制这场事故。
texts.en:
A drastic breach has occurred! Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been compromised during a clandestine visit to the surface of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Some details remain unclear for now, but [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] came into brief and direct contact with a native [from.target.GetSpeciesName], who promptly fled the scene. Our operatives moved to try and apprehend this witness, but their efforts have so far failed.

Operation [from.GetName] remains in progress for now, but we have activated special measures until this breach can be contained.

label.zh: 逮住这个[from.target.GetSpeciesName]，让它从这世界上消失。
label.en: Hunt this [from.target.GetSpeciesName] down and eliminate them.

label.zh: 太放肆了！我们必须中止行动。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现本次行动的名称。
note.en: In the game, the operation's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏会按这位人物的性别选用代词。
note.en: The game picks the pronoun that fits this character.

note.en: In the game, the name of the local species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
那个目睹我们最近入侵[from.target.GetName]的[from.target.GetSpeciesName]不仅仍然在逃遁，甚至还向我们发出了粗暴的最后通牒。这个目击者威胁要揭露我们的间谍首脑——除此之外还有[from.owner.GetName]——我们是如何对[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的事务进行插足干涉的。

这个厚颜无耻的家伙通过待在人口稠密的地区来阻挠我们，在那里我们不能在没有暴露风险的情况下对它采取什么措施。我们或许干脆就同意此人的要求算了。
texts.en:
The [from.target.GetSpeciesName] who witnessed our recent breach in the [from.target.GetName] is not only still at large, but has delivered us a crude ultimatum. The witness threatens to expose our Spymaster - and by extension, the [from.owner.GetName] - for our interference in [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] affairs.

This brazen individual keeps us at bay by remaining in heavily-populated areas, where we cannot act against them without fear of further exposure. We may instead wish to simply meet their demands.

label.zh: 不可接受。中止行动，立即撤退。
我们绝不进行谈判。消灭目击者。
label.en: We will not negotiate. Eliminate the witness.

label.zh: 大出血的价格，但是我们会出这个钱。
label.en: A steep price, but we will pay.

tooltips.zh:
我们将指派特工对此人进行全时监控，确保整个过程的隐秘性。
这会对我们的渗透速度产生负面效应。
tooltips.en:
Operatives will be assigned to monitor this individual at all times, ensuring complete secrecy.
This will negatively impact our Infiltration Speed.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们干涉[pre_ftl_country.GetName]自然发展。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了不予干涉法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our interference in the natural development of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] is in violation of the Equal Standing Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh: 我们的特工报告，他们成功地消灭了目标：我们最近在[from.target.GetName]入侵的唯一目击者。我们追踪这个人到达某个大型[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]定居点郊区的一处偏远住所。这位目击者似乎处于极度震惊的状态，没有迹象表明此人与其他[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进行了接触。我们确信该事件已经得到了控制。
texts.en: Our operatives report the successful elimination of their target: the sole witness to our recent breach in the [from.target.GetName]. This individual was tracked to a remote dwelling on the outskirts of a major [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] settlement. The witness appeared to be in an extreme state of shock, and there are no signs they came into contact with other [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are confident that this matter has been contained.

texts.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_country.GetName]违反不予干涉法案一事发生后，已经向[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员递交了完整报告。希望这种坦白的行为能让检察官对我们有好感，他们或许会对我们的案子从宽处理。
texts.en: We have submitted a full report to officials at the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], following our violation of the Non-Interference Act in the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. Hopefully this confessional act of disclosure will endear us to prosecutors, who may in turn consider our case more leniently.

[Root.GetName]在接下来的五年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Following our violation of the Equal Standing Act due to our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName], we have submitted the requisite paperwork to the officials of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. Hopefully, by admitting our actions they will be more tolerant.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next five years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

summary.text:
# [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]暴露 / [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] Exposed
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 间谍行动随机插曲（前FTL）pre-FTL espionage operation interlude
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_operations_events.txt:2684-2992` · `common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt:2840-3260`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

随机插曲池（`espionage_event_effects.txt:2908–3260`）：按‘我方普通/格式塔 × 目标普通/蜂巢’分四个池，池内各项权重 1：普通→普通、格式塔→普通。出现的概率：章节检定失败时 10/400（无外貌改造科技 ×1.5），同一行动 120 天一次。本事件的限制：不用于“提高觉醒度”行动。 / Fired from the roll-failure interlude pool (普通→普通、格式塔→普通): 10-in-400 chance per failed chapter roll, once per 120 days per operation. Restrictions: Never for the increase-awareness operation.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**间谍头子暴露（3050）**：间谍头子在地表被一名本地人发现。A 继续；B 追杀目击者 → 80% **3051 目击者被消灭** / 20% **3055 敲诈**；C 中止；D 通知银河共同体 → 违反法案的 preftl.10155 / 10055。**3055 敲诈**：撤退 / 灭口（再次触发违反法案 preftl.10150 / 10050）/ 付钱。 / Spymaster Exposed (3050): A carry on, B hunt the witness → 80% 3051 / 20% 3055 blackmail, C abort, D report to the Galactic Community (Breach act events). 3055: retreat, kill the witness (Breach events) or pay.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

3051 / 3055 互斥（80/20）；D 路线单独。 / 3051 / 3055 exclusive (80:20); option D separate.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。 / None.

- 已核对 Checked：脚本、四个池中的出现条件、各选项对成功度变量的修改。/ Script, pool conditions and the success-variable changes.
- 审阅改动 Changes：结构已按源码核对（原编译结构正确）。/ Structure checked against the source and kept.
